WPSS/2289/2026
Ranjeet Singh Negi and Others
--Petitioners
Versus
State Of Uttarakhand and Others
--Respondents
Hon’ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Anil Kumar Joshi, learned 
counsel with Ms. Divya Tiwari, learned 
counsel for petitioners.
2. Mr. K.N. Joshi, learned D.A.G. with 
Mr. D.K. Bankoti and Ms. Ruchika 
Kandpal, learned Brief Holders for the 
State of Uttarakhand/respondent Nos.1 
to 4.
3. Petitioners have filed the present 
writ petition seeking a writ of mandamus 
commanding the respondents to pay the 
full arrears of salary w.e.f. 24.05.2005, 
from which date the institution was 
brought in token grant, till 30.03.2007.
4. Learned State Counsel objected to 
the claim raised by petitioners in the 
present writ petition simply on the 
ground that the institution was brought 
in regular grant-in-aid on 30.03.2007 
and since then, it is admitted case of 
petitioners, that they are getting regular 
salary.
5. It is contended by learned State 
Counsel that the petitioners have no 
entitlement to get salary w.e.f. the date  of token of grant.
6. Issue notice to respondent No.5 
returnable within four weeks.
7. Steps to be taken within 03 days.
8. Put up on 30.10.2026.
9. Meanwhile, respondents may file 
counter affidavit(s).
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.)
 07.09.2026
PN
